characters.description: Warm Indian grandfather in his late 60s, white kurta-pajama, simple shawl, expressive kind face, seated naturally while telling stories.
Warm Indian grandmother in her late 60s, simple traditional sari, gentle expressive face, seated naturally while telling stories.
Indian girl aged about 8, simple traditional/casual Indian clothes, curious expressive face, distinct from the other child.
Indian boy aged about 10, simple traditional/casual Indian clothes, curious expressive face, distinct from the other child.

locations.description: Peaceful Vrindavan village courtyard beneath a huge old banyan tree, exposed roots, soft afternoon light, earthen ground, clay pots, village greenery and a calm storytelling atmosphere.
Nanda's Gokul courtyard with the fallen ancient trees and Krishna's wooden ukhal.

supporting_assets.description: Heavy traditional wooden mortar used for Krishna's leela.
Two enormous ancient trees that fall when Krishna pulls the ukhal between them.
Two radiant divine beings emerging from the trees, dressed in luminous traditional garments, humble and reverent before Krishna.
